task: In src/board/toolbars.tsx, add an optional `title?: string` prop to LayerButtons (destructured in its parameter object, defaulting to 'Layer'), and pass `title="Ordenar"` at the LayerButtons call site inside ShapeFormatToolbar.

steps.goal: Locate the LayerButtons definition and its call site inside ShapeFormatToolbar in src/board/toolbars.tsx.
Add the optional title prop to LayerButtons and pass title="Ordenar" at the ShapeFormatToolbar call site.
steps.edit_spec: In the LayerButtons definition, add `title?: string` to its props type (or inline parameter object type) and destructure it as `title = 'Layer'`. Use the destructured value in the component body so it is not unused; if a literal `'Layer'` label exists, replace that usage with `{title}`, otherwise insert `void title;` immediately after the destructuring. In the ShapeFormatToolbar component, find the `<LayerButtons` JSX call and add the attribute `title="Ordenar"` to that element only.

acceptance_check.cmd: if ((Select-String -Path src/board/toolbars.tsx -Pattern "title\?: string" | Measure-Object).Count -ge 1 -and (Select-String -Path src/board/toolbars.tsx -Pattern "title = 'Layer'" | Measure-Object).Count -ge 1 -and (Select-String -Path src/board/toolbars.tsx -Pattern 'title="Ordenar"' | Measure-Object).Count -ge 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }
